title: Can this GCP request path carry peak load with useful reserve?
description: Choose a workload and compute model, then change peak demand, cache hit rate, and reserve. The visible origin load, capacity, failure margin, and monthly envelope update together.
disclaimer: Every unit rate is an illustrative teaching assumption, not a Google Cloud quote. Replace it with current regional pricing, discounts, support, taxes, and measured workload telemetry before budgeting.
